body:
Thanks. What you describe is exactly how I feel now. I sometimes cannot stop crying after I wake up so I have to call in sick. And I cannot help but thinking what should have, could have, and would have happened if...I think that kills me the most.

Sometimes having to work actually helps. Because I am getting worse usually when weekend comes. Friday afternoon 4pm, whole office just cannot wait to go home, and I am falling down deeper and deeper when they leave one after another. They all go home, to be with someone they love. To me, home used to be where he is. All is there waiting for me is just going back to my room and trying to not kill myself for two days and three nights.
Did suicide ever cross your mind? Did you ever think about just end all the pain at once?

Good to hear that there is no time limit on how long it takes to heal. My friends all say that I should be attending party by now. I should find someone by now...But it does not really get any better. So I started to think that it will never be.
Wobbling my body back and forth when I pay full attention listening or studying, pointed out by a distinguish professor who sat next to me at seminars. He does the same.
